001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.CampaignFleetAIAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc.Token;
013
014
015/**
016 * If the variable is set and with a longer duration, does nothing.
017 * SetNearbyFleetsVariable <range> <faction id> <variable name> <value> <duration>
018 */
019public class SetNearbyFleetsVariable extends BaseCommandPlugin {
020        
021        //BroadcastPlayerAction <type> <range> <responseVariable>
022        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
023        
024                
025                float range = Float.parseFloat(params.get(0).string);
026                String factionId = params.get(1).getString(memoryMap);
027                String varName = params.get(2).string;
028                String value = params.get(3).getString(memoryMap);
029                float dur = Float.parseFloat(params.get(4).string);
030                
031                final SectorEntityToken target = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
032                if (target.getContainingLocation() == null) return false;
033                
034                List<CampaignFleetAPI> fleets = target.getContainingLocation().getFleets();
035                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : fleets) {
036                        if (fleet == target) continue;
037                        if (!fleet.getFaction().getId().equals(factionId)) continue;
038                        if (fleet.getAI() instanceof CampaignFleetAIAPI) {
039                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(target.getLocation(), fleet.getLocation());
040                                if (dist <= range) {
041                                        float expire = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getExpire(varName);
042                                        boolean has = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(varName);
043                                        if (!has || (expire != -1 && expire < dur)) {
044                                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(varName, value, dur);
045                                        }
046                                }
047                        }
048                }
049                
050                return true;
051        }
052        
053
054}
